coverage_claim: WM-ECO-028 covers a governed Advertisement / Promotion specification family through mandatory discriminated advertisement and sales-promotion profiles, identity, parties, claims, evidence, disclosures, creative and placement bindings, promotion mechanics, terms, lifecycle, observations, risk, remedy, provenance, access and loss-aware projections. Relation, channel, sector, jurisdiction, implementation-conformance and independent-review questions remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The registry slash label is resolved as one specification family with a mandatory subtype discriminator, not one interchangeable instance class. Advertisement and sales-promotion instances share promotional governance services but preserve separate class criteria, properties, operations and external masters.

decisions.rationale: Every instance declares advertisement or sales-promotion subtype. Shared identity, authority, evidence, lifecycle, access and projection services do not make the subtypes equivalent.
The unified registry supplies Creative Work as a parent hint but the frozen relation ledger has no settled WM-ECO-028 edge, so it grants no containment or cascade authority.
A campaign coordinates activity, a promotional instrument defines governed claims or benefit mechanics, and a creative work owns expression and rights.

decisions.concept: Claim, qualification, evidence, endorsement and disclosure
decisions.rationale: Each has its own source, method, scope, revision, validity and challenge status. Evidence supports a claim but does not automatically prove it.

decisions.concept: Sponsor, advertiser, beneficiary, payer, publisher, seller, intermediary and endorser
decisions.rationale: The roles may be assigned to different parties and preserve separate authority, responsibility, conflict and disclosure context.

decisions.concept: Promotion mechanic, offer, price, entitlement, redemption and settlement
decisions.rationale: The model owns the presented benefit mechanics and terms. Authoritative commercial eligibility, entitlement, transaction, clearing, payment and accounting outcomes remain external.
Internal approval never proves legal compliance, and release or availability never proves a presentation, serve, impression or view.

decisions.concept: Serve, impression, viewability, interaction, conversion and redemption
decisions.rationale: Each observation preserves identity, source, method, denominator, invalid-traffic handling, time and uncertainty and cannot prove the next state.
Purpose, lawful basis, consent, objection, suppression, sensitive data, minors, protected groups and prohibited practices remain separate and jurisdiction scoped.
AdCOM, OpenRTB, Native, VAST, taxonomies, supply-chain and measurement artefacts support digital advertising but cannot narrow the canonical model to programmatic media.
Digital Coupon Management and GCN support coupon identity and process bindings but do not define every promotion or prove redemption settlement.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-028 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Slash-boundary hold: advertisement and sales-promotion remain mandatory discriminated profiles and operational evidence may later justify separate model identities.
Relation hold: WM-MED-001 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-028 edge.
Identity hold: campaign, promotional instrument, advertisement, sales promotion, creative, claim, placement, dissemination, interaction, redemption and settlement remain distinct.
Claim hold: qualification, omission, comparative basis, evidence, test, endorsement, material connection, sponsor, payer, disclosure and challenge status remain explicit.

State hold: approval never proves legality, release never proves dissemination, impression never proves viewability or response, attribution never proves causality and redemption never proves settlement.

Targeting and privacy hold: purpose, lawful basis, consent, objection, suppression, prohibited attributes, sensitive data, minors, protected groups and vulnerability safeguards remain jurisdiction scoped.
Commercial hold: promotion benefit, offer, price, entitlement, transaction, discount allocation, clearing, payment and ledger consequences remain separate masters.
Source-access hold: two GS1 resources were verified through official indexed content while direct automated access was publisher-blocked.

Profile hold: broadcast, print, out-of-home, search, social, influencer, retail, direct, native, video, audio, political, health, finance, alcohol, gambling, children and environmental-claim uses need separate profiles.
Interoperability hold: every IAB, GS1, EU, FTC, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Review hold: legal, privacy, consumer-protection, accessibility, advertising-operations, promotion, tax, accounting and independent external review are outstanding.
deferred_research: Canonically adjudicate the WM-MED-001 parent signal and register relations to campaign, creative, content, product, service, offer, price, party, audience, consent, placement, communication, observation, transaction, finance, complaint, enforcement and records models.
Evaluate whether channel and transaction implementations require Advertisement and Sales Promotion to become separate canonical models while preserving this family as an assembly.
Create broadcast, print, out-of-home, search, social, influencer, retail, direct, native, video, audio, political, health, finance, alcohol, gambling, children and environmental-claim profiles.

Benchmark and conformance-test claim substantiation, disclosure prominence, seller authorization, supply-path, invalid-traffic, viewability, targeting, eligibility, redemption and settlement mappings.
Validate jurisdiction, channel, protected-group, minors, prohibited-product, green-claim, endorsement, accessibility, tax, accounting, privacy, complaint, takedown and records policies.

Pin exact IAB and GS1 release artefacts and obtain independent advertising, promotion, legal, privacy, accessibility, finance and data-governance review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
